Most lifters aim somewhere around 0.7 to 1 gram of protein per pound of bodyweight a day, which is roughly 1.6 to 2.2 grams per kilogram. Spreading it over three or four meals, with a solid serving at each, works better than saving it all for dinner.

That's a general range, not a target for you. If you'd like numbers worked out from your own weight and goal, I can set your targets in the app. For anything specific to a medical condition, a dietitian is the right call.
